result.topic_en: Numerical tables: a frequency count by five-year age groups (total 177), two cumulative-style columns of counts with their sums, and an upside-down table of three columns of logarithms in which each column differs from the previous one by a constant.

methods.what: Summation of a frequency table by five-year age classes
Second column formed by adding the age-class frequencies to the first column, with column totals
Table of logarithms in which each successive column is obtained by subtracting a constant (about 0,49352, then 1,01703) from the previous one
